import sys

def func(x: float, n: float) -> float:
    return -n * (n * n - 3 * n - 3 * x * x + 9 * x - 4) / (2 * (x - 2) * (x - 1) * x)

def find_ans(x: int, p: float, n: int) -> int:
    if n > x:
        return 0
    if func(x, n) >= p:
        return n
    return find_ans(x, p, n + 1)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x = int(data[0])
    p = float(data[1])
    ans = find_ans(x, p, 0)
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
